tldr: This push adds password reset by email and fixes a bug where the sprint board showed archived tasks.
done_for_project: Users can reset their password from the login page
Archived tasks no longer appear on the sprint board
not_done_yet: Reset email template is plain text — styled version still to do
risks: Needs RESEND_API_KEY set in Vercel env vars, otherwise emails won't send

commits.title: feat(auth): add password reset by email
commits.why: Users who forgot their password had no way back in except asking the admin.
what: Server action that sends a one-time link via Supabase Auth

files.explanation: The form where the user types their email

snippet.explanation: Asks Supabase to email a reset link that brings the user back to /update-password.

commits.title: fix(board): hide archived tasks
commits.why: The board query didn't filter on the archived flag.
what: Added .eq('archived', false) to the board query

git_operations.explanation: Checked GitHub for new commits from others — none, so no conflict risk.
Uploaded the 2 local commits to GitHub's main branch.

concepts.explanation: Commits live only on your Mac until you push; pushing copies them to GitHub.

quiz.question: Which change fixes the sprint board?
options: A filter on the archived flag in the board query

quiz.question: What must be configured on Vercel for reset emails to work?
quiz.explanation: Without the API key the email provider rejects the send.

quiz.question: Before this push, where were the 2 commits?
Where does the 'Forgot password?' link live?
quiz.explanation: The link was added to the login page; the reset form itself is a new page.

quiz.question: What did git fetch do before the push?
options: Checked GitHub for commits you don't have
quiz.explanation: fetch only downloads info about remote commits; it changes nothing in your files.

headline: Password reset by email + sprint board fix
